source: Linear GraphQL responses captured live through the connected Clankie app (linear_graphql) on 2026-10-15 ~02:50Z for KH2 Multiplayer, each exactly the query collectLinearOutcomes sent (VUH-2282). Issue titles are blanked; everything else is verbatim.

calls.query: query($id:String!, $after:String) { project(id:$id) { issues(first:50, after:$after, includeArchived:true, filter:{ state: { type: { eq: "started" } } }) { nodes { id identifier title updatedAt completedAt state { name type } parent { id identifier } children(first:1) { nodes { id } } projectMilestone { id } stateHistory(first:25) { nodes { startedAt endedAt state { name type } } pageInfo { hasNextPage } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }

query($id:String!, $after:String) { project(id:$id) { issues(first:50, after:$after, includeArchived:true, filter:{ updatedAt: { gte: "2026-10-06T05:00:00.000Z" } }) { nodes { id identifier title updatedAt completedAt state { name type } parent { id identifier } children(first:1) { nodes { id } } projectMilestone { id } stateHistory(first:25) { nodes { startedAt endedAt state { name type } } pageInfo { hasNextPage } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }

query($id:String!, $after:String) { project(id:$id) { issues(first:50, after:$after, includeArchived:true, filter:{ updatedAt: { gte: "2026-10-06T05:00:00.000Z" } }) { nodes { id identifier title updatedAt completedAt state { name type } parent { id identifier } children(first:1) { nodes { id } } projectMilestone { id } stateHistory(first:25) { nodes { startedAt endedAt state { name type } } pageInfo { hasNextPage } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }

query($id:String!, $after:String) { project(id:$id) { projectMilestones(first:25, after:$after) { nodes { id name issues(first:50) { nodes { id state { name type } completedAt } pageInfo { hasNextPage } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }
query($id:String!, $after:String) { project(id:$id) { projectUpdates(first:50, after:$after, orderBy: createdAt) { nodes { id createdAt url health } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }
